entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: A framework that leverages external structured knowledge graphs to improve contextual understanding of LMs and generate more informed responses.

entities.name: graph retriever
entities.description: A component that models the distribution p_theta(G|q,G) to select the optimal subgraph.

entities.name: answer generator
entities.description: A component that models the distribution p_phi(a|q,G) to generate the answer given the query and subgraph.

entities.name: downstream tasks
entities.description: General applications where GraphRAG enhances answers by retrieving relevant knowledge.

relationships.description: GraphRAG utilizes a graph retriever to model the selection of the optimal subgraph.
GraphRAG utilizes an answer generator to produce the final response.
The goal of GraphRAG is to enhance the answers of downstream tasks.
